text:
Marta C.: Heads-up: customer onboarding hit a parity + mapping issue for embeddings+rerank. Node SDK with batch_helper lost an item after a sub-batch retry; python returned all items. Also saw one vector with a different dim which broke their reranker.

Ben S.: can you paste the smallest repro and raw http order? sounds like positional stitch + model-fallback dim change.

Marta C.: repro: send 6 inputs, batch_helper.max_batch_size=4 -> sub-batches (4,2). server returns 200, then a 502 for second sub-batch which triggers client retry. Node final array has 5 vectors, python has 6. One returned vector had 640 dims vs expected 1024.

Ishaan R.: node helper historically used index-based concat for perf. python attaches per-item ids. If a replayed chunk is trimmed by server (dedupe on replay) index merge can lose items.

Talia V.: quick mitigation: set batch_helper.tag_ids=true in node or disable the helper. Also server supports opt-in header X-Response-Shape: object_items to return per-item metadata (model_id, dim, client_id).

Marta C.: tag_ids=true fixed the missing item in my quick test and object_items exposed the dim so reranker could decide to keep it. Customer wanted a smoother default.

Ben S.: proposal: auto-enable compact tags when retry/backoff > 0. Use a compact_id (6 bytes) namespaced by request_ts+seq to avoid collisions. Also add server meta.dedupe_count and echo sub_batch_ids so clients can detect replays quickly.

Ishaan R.: alternative: server could return a position_map mapping original client_seq -> returned_index; keeps the old array shape while enabling reconciliation. Downside: extra meta payload. Both approaches are reasonable.

Talia V.: migration for response shape: opt-in header X-Response-Shape: object_items for one release, then flip default after two releases. SDKs update in lockstep. Add docs note for batch_helper.tag_ids and auth refresh replay.

sdk-bot: Created DEVEX-5601: "node: auto-enable compact_id when retry/backoff set; server add dedupe_count & sub_batch_ids; opt-in object_items response"  https://rwd.in/DEVEX-5601

Marta C.: i'll attach a minimal node+python repro and raw HTTP trace to DEVEX-5601. Also request a short onboarding note so sales/CS can advise customers to enable tag_ids during onboarding.

Ben S.: adding a small CLI fuzz test that simulates sub-batch 500/502 and fallback model variant so SDKs have coverage. We'll also log dedupe_count>0 as a warning in telemetry.

Marta C.: thanks all. temporary mitigation note for CS: set batch_helper.tag_ids=true and/or use X-Response-Shape: object_items until default lands. I'll follow up with repro. :thumbsup:
